reviews.text: Thank you so much for your transparency. Could you please explain your review so we and the reader can understand what you didn't like? Thanks.

I've often taken my dog ​​to this groomer, but the last time, there was absolutely no transparency in communicating the cost. Besides the undisclosed price increase, the real problem was that my dog ​​was charged an additional €20 treatment, which NOT ONLY wasn't requested at the start of the treatment, BUT ABOVE ALL, the possible and hypothetical need for the treatment wasn't communicated. The groomer should have informed us of the possibility of this treatment and let us choose, rather than leaving us with a surprise at the checkout. Total €70
Very professional and kind, excellent service. The staff is very helpful and attentive to every detail. Bruno, the dachshund.

I've been going to this groomer for many years, they're great! Everything works great, and the person who washes my dogs is very professional, attentive, and also very empathetic with dogs. Mine are almost "happy" to go to the wash...haha. It's also a clean and tidy environment, and the shop, although small, offers a wide range of products. Congratulations, Sofy Mama, I've been to many dog ​​groomers, but honestly, you are the best.
Very kind and very good

Did you know that even if you're sick, even if you end up in the hospital or have a fever of 104°F on the day you were supposed to go get your dog groomed, and for these reasons (more than valid and insurmountable) you couldn't fulfill your commitment and canceled, you still have to pay the full price for the service not rendered!!! Yes, in contempt of any law, consumer rights, or even rights in general, as well as the most basic sense of loyalty and empathy...for them, lost earnings come before everything else, even health. After 7 years of punctual appointments, for a legitimate cancellation they charged my mother the full price even though they couldn't bring her dog due to force majeure. Their ignorance of the principle "ad impossibilia nemo tenetur" caused them to lose not only a customer but also face! Terrible experience. They don't think about the customers' needs, but only about their potential "lost revenue."
Very kind and animal lovers
Thank you so much! Our border terrier is just a new dog! You did a splendid job ! Our dog is just beautiful and was treated with so much kindness 💕 we'll be back ❤️ …

I've been coming here since my dog ​​Bruto was a puppy. Today he weighs over 70 kg, but at the grooming salon he becomes a real teddy bear: relaxed, calm, and happy.
How would you describe the staff? Professionalism, love for dogs, and a special relationship with each animal. Truly wonderful people.
Now I'll show you what Bruto thinks of the grooming, or rather, the spa day!
P.S. A special thanks to Laura ❤️❤️
I've been taking my dog ​​to them for 7 years, they're great and always make me happy.
I brought my dachshund, the girl was really helpful and kind, she even gave her a biscuit at the end of the bath 🥰 …
Thank you so much 🙏 …

Thank you for everything you do. I brought my dog ​​here and have never received such service. This place shows that caring for our four-legged friends comes first: from the highest-quality products to the extreme professionalism with which all grooming is performed. Above all, thank you for your immense kindness and professionalism. Highly recommended ✌🏻
Excellent and professional!! Congratulations 👌😉 …
Thank you 😁 …
Knowledgeable and friendly staff. Thanks for the valuable advice!

I took my poodle in for an ultrasound teeth cleaning this morning. My trusted vet recommended Andrea to me.
I was very satisfied. In fact, for those who complain about the costs, last week when I made the appointment, the girl told me prices started at.... and I paid much less than the amount I was quoted, so I can only say that they are very honest and, above all, very good.

Disappointed by the attitude of the woman who "cared" for my Bullmastiff.
Unfortunately, she wasn't capable of handling a 70-pound dog. Annoyed that it was the dog's fault for hurting her hand while moving him.
But what fault is it of the dog or us owners if the groomer wasn't capable?
I recommend you schedule appointments with different groomers for each breed you bring in.
The dog came home damp and odorless...

It's a shame I'm only reading your inadequate response today. The dog had already been brought to you, and the sitting problem hadn't occurred. Don't make up stupid things, and stay humble and avoid offending the customer. Get off your pedestal; you're certainly the last person who can give us advice on how to handle a 70-pound animal. If he's upset by the girl's incompetence, it's not the owner's or the dog's fault, but rather the inadequate operator. Instead of leaving, he could have stayed. The shop is his, not mine.
Good luck to his entire family.

We were fortunate enough to take our Toy Poodle to Mrs. Laura for a grooming session. We must admit that the job was done with great professionalism, and we are extremely pleased with the result. Our furry friend showed no signs of stress or tension. On the contrary, he enjoyed a very pleasant experience. Thank you so much, Laura (Andrea, Dream's dad).
Very high prices

I took my dog ​​to be washed and trimmed, knowing she's a difficult dog to groom and weighs 9 pounds. We arrived at 5:00 PM and returned at 6:00 PM because the groomer told us it would take an hour. We were charged €45 because the groomer said the dog was too demanding and that her behavior had caused him to miss three appointments, and that it had taken two hours, despite us leaving the shop at 6:15 PM. We're sorry the groomer encountered so many problems, but we expected more honesty and professionalism, given that he's a trained expert, as he'd made clear to us numerous times.

I took my Yorkshire Terrier for grooming and it was a truly positive experience! The staff was very kind and attentive, and the environment was clean and welcoming. My puppy came home with a well-groomed coat, a lovely smell, and they even trimmed his nails.
Excellent service, I recommend it!
Thank you 🙏 ❤️ …
Thank you so much ❤️
First time at Sofy Mama, and it exceeded expectations. Cannella did a teeth cleaning with fantastic results, and they even recommended some dental hygiene products. Thank you so much!
Really good girls 👏👏👏 …

Here are two photos to show how much these two care about showing off their look.
I met Laura on Instagram and tried one of their products out of curiosity. One Saturday, I traveled to the other side of Rome (40 minutes well spent) and had them groomed. Besides the smell of a clean dog, not a dog full of products that need to be washed again after three days, Laura was the only one who recognized the breed of my long-haired Lilly. She was taken from a country litter, and for 13 years, I had no idea how to best care for her fur. I've seen many groomers, but each one has told me different things and given me different, abominable cuts.
As soon as we got home, besides the joy of feeling clean—because yes, they love being clean, too—forget about "I wash them twice a year"—no, sir, they're not wolves! They collapsed into a beautiful, snoring sleep.
What more can I say... we'll take these trips on the Cassia! Hugs to Laura and the team!
They are fantastic! I have a 3 year old Maremma Sheepdog who is very selective with both dogs and humans. When she comes into their home she transforms and feels at home.
Good morning, thank you for your review. Could we kindly ask you what you didn't like about our products/services so we can improve?

Congratulations on the transparency and clarity of your reviews on a day when we don't have any customers with your name. We invite you to express your disappointment so that everyone reading can understand. Kind regards
Very kind...

Good evening
I've been a customer of this business for a long time.
I take Bubba, a golden retriever-type, about twice a year.
I have absolutely no complaints about the service they provide.
The woman who usually takes care of Bubba is very kind, patient, and good, and that's one of the reasons I trust them.
But unfortunately, this will be the last time I use them.
Today I paid 65 euros for a wash and trim!!
Insane price!!
I've always paid 45 euros for a wash and additional services (nails, ear cleaning, and trims).
When I asked to understand such an excessive price increase since the last time (about 7 months ago), they explained that it was due to higher bills and because Bubba had shed (like the previous times I took her) and therefore it took longer to dry her.
I was then advised to take her more often so the dog wouldn't have to shed her undercoat.
I find this price excessive, at least for me!
I paid, but I won't be able to use their services anymore.
I thank the girl who's always lovely with my dog, but I won't be able to be their customer anymore because they've decided to only cater to high-spending clients and not to the average customer.
I'll find another place with more reasonable prices.
Patience!
I don't think it will matter to them.
Best regards.

Well done!!! A long stripping job... so much patience.
Fantastic result
Professional and loving guys with furry friends, I bring my Teo every month and I am very happy with the work done, you can tell they do it with passion 😍 …
Well done... I love you

Very kind and well-trained staff.
I highly recommend entrusting your pets to them👍👍👍 …
Optimal
I often bring my Maltese here, they are professional, punctual, and put passion and love into their work
Thank you so much ❤️
